rows.note: Use this for a prank or practical joke rather than a financial scam.

example.english: Their fake cockroach prank was a really over-the-top humbug.
example.traditional: 佢哋喺我張枱度放咗隻假蟑螂，真係過分嘅惡作劇。

rows.note: Use this for the fraud or sham sense, especially a deceptive scheme.

example.english: This investment scheme is simply a humbug; don't fall for it.
example.traditional: 呢個投資計劃根本係一場騙局，千祈唔好落搭。

rows.note: Use this for the peppermint hard-sweet sense.

example.english: I loved eating a striped humbug when I was little.
